tools.name: app_handoff
tools.description: Assign the whole execution scope to an independent app-managed worker. Returns acceptance immediately. Finish this turn after the receipt; the app will deliver app_task_result in a later turn.

tools.name: app_send_message
tools.description: Send instructions or a follow-up to the same worker task/session. Busy workers receive steering; idle workers start a new turn. Returns acceptance, not the completed result.

acceptance_message: The app owns this task. Finish this turn; app_task_result will arrive when the worker finishes.
